support_claim: The CRM row for VEL-19 lists the counterparty as 'Vellum Print Co' while billing records the billed name as 'Vellum Print Co Ltd', with no observation explicitly linking these two referents.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; the packet provides only name-adjacent labels across systems without an identifier bridge or explicit identity assertion, so neither burden is met.
